area.label: Area
area.description: Land area from the supplied country table.

population.label: Population
population.description: Population estimate for the indicated reference year where available.

net.label: Net salary
net.description: Monthly net wage as reported or estimated in the source.

rent.label: Rent
rent.description: Estimated monthly rent. Location and dwelling definitions vary by source.

essentials.label: Essentials
essentials.description: Modelled monthly essential expenses before rent.

left.label: Money left
left.description: Monthly balance after rent and essential expenses.

rent_burden.label: Rent burden
rent_burden.description: Rent divided by net salary, calculated when both are available.

income_group.label: Income group
income_group.description: Income grouping recorded in Natural Earth Admin 0.

language.label: Languages
language.description: Language codes and English proficiency as recorded in the source.
